sentence: Feed your bronutholes the sprungpeanemis. They will not finish it.

wombos.definition: A rapid-fire peak cinema analysis — a peanemis delivered at full speed, cycling through multiple gears of intensity like sprinting, running, and jogging all at once.
wombos.example: He hit us with a full sprungpeanemis before anyone could even sit down.

wombos.definition: A pair or group of bros who are simultaneously donut holes and a-holes — freshly glazed in audacity. Used to describe friends who are lovably insufferable.
wombos.example: We pulled up to Uncin' Dunknuts acting like a couple of bronutholes.
